title: Andrographolide induces ferroptosis in colorectal cancer via P53-mediated downregulation of the SLC7A11/GPX4 signaling pathway.
authors: Wang, Wanting; Yan, Suying; Ma, Mingqian; Chen, Tianyi; Liu, Chang; Liang, Weizheng; Zhao, Xinzhu; Zhao, Kailong; Xue, Jun; Yu, Haiyang; Niu, Kaijun; Su, Xiaomin; Zhang, Chunze
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究穿心莲内酯通过P53下调SLC7A11/GPX4通路诱导结直肠癌铁死亡，属纯细胞/动物实验，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is the second leading cause of cancer-related deaths. Those with advanced CRC continue to face a poor prognosis. Ferroptosis, a form of regulated cell death marked by iron accumulation, reactive oxygen species (ROS) elevation, and lipid peroxidation which represents a potential therapeutic strategy, particularly given the high iron and ROS levels often found in CRC cells. Andrographolide (AP), a diterpene lactone derived from Andrographis paniculata, has emerged as a potential anticancer agent. However, its ability to induce ferroptosis in CRC cells and the underlying mechanisms remain to be elucidated. PURPOSE: This study aims to investigate whether AP can induce ferroptosis in colorectal cancer cells and to elucidate the underlying molecular mechanisms, both in vitro and in vivo. METHODS: The effects and mechanisms of AP were examined in LoVo and HCT8 cells using various assays, including the CCK8 assay. The levels of mRNA in AP-treated cells were detected by transcriptome sequencing and verified by RT-qPCR as well as Westernblot. Network pharmacology and molecular docking techniques were employed to identify the drug's targets, alongside knockdown and overexpression experiments in cells to validate these targets. And in vivo patient-derived xenograft (PDX) model was constructed to assess the anti-tumor effects of AP in vivo and to validate the conclusions drawn from the in vitro experiments. RESULTS: AP effectively inhibited the proliferation and migration of LoVo and HCT8 cells and promoted their apoptosis. Transcriptome sequencing indicated that AP's inhibition of CRC was associated with ferroptosis. Subsequent experiments confirmed this prediction. The ferroptosis inhibitor Fer-1 attenuated the cytotoxic effects of AP on LoVo and HCT8 cells. AP treatment also resulted in AP treatment also resulted in mitochondrial dysfunction in both cell lines. Additionally, the expression levels of intracellular Solute Larrier Camily 7 Member 11 (SLC7A11) and Glutathione Peroxidase 4 (GPX4) were significantly reduced, while Glutathione/Oxidized glutathione (GSH/GSSG) levels decreased and the concentrations of Malondialdehyde (MDA) and free iron increased significantly. These effects were enhanced by Erastin and mitigated by Ferrostatin-1 (Fer-1). Network pharmacology and molecular docking predicted P53 as one of the core targets of AP for in CRC teratment. Knockdown and overexpression of P53 in LoVo and HCT8 cells lead to changes in downstream signaling pathways. Futhermore, in vivo studies using the PDX nude mouse model demonstrated that AP inhibited tumor growth, an effect that was reduced by Fer-1. The expression levels of SLC7A11 and GPX4, alongside the changes in GSH/GSSG, MDA, and free iron content, were consistent with the in vitro findings. CONCLUSION: Our data demonstrate that AP can induce ferroptosis in colorectal cancer by downregulating the SLC7A11/GPX4 signaling pathway, with P53 potentially serving as its target.
abstract_zh: 背景：结直肠癌（CRC）是癌症相关死亡的第二大原因。晚期CRC患者预后仍然较差。铁死亡（ferroptosis）是一种以铁积累、活性氧（ROS）升高和脂质过氧化为特征的程序性细胞死亡形式，代表了一种潜在的治疗策略，尤其是考虑到CRC细胞中通常含有高水平的铁和ROS。穿心莲内酯（Andrographolide, AP）是一种源自穿心莲（Andrographis paniculata）的二萜内酯，已显示出作为潜在抗癌药物的前景。然而，其在CRC细胞中诱导铁死亡的能力及其潜在机制仍有待阐明。目的：本研究旨在探讨AP是否能在结直肠癌细胞中诱导铁死亡，并在体外和体内阐明其潜在分子机制。方法：使用多种检测方法（包括CCK8检测）在LoVo和HCT8细胞中检测AP的作用和机制。通过转录组测序检测AP处理细胞中的mRNA水平，并通过RT-qPCR和Western blot验证。采用网络药理学和分子对接技术识别药物靶点，同时在细胞中进行敲低和过表达实验以验证这些靶点。此外，构建体内患者来源异种移植（PDX）模型，以评估AP在体内的抗肿瘤作用，并验证体外实验得出的结论。结果：AP有效抑制LoVo和HCT8细胞的增殖和迁移，并促进其凋亡。转录组测序表明，AP对CRC的抑制作用与铁死亡相关。后续实验证实了这一预测。铁死亡抑制剂Fer-1减弱了AP对LoVo和HCT8细胞的细胞毒性作用。AP处理还导致两种细胞系中的线粒体功能障碍。此外，细胞内溶质载体家族7成员11（SLC7A11）和谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶4（GPX4）的表达水平显著降低，而谷胱甘肽/氧化型谷胱甘肽（GSH/GSSG）水平下降，丙二醛（MDA）和游离铁浓度显著增加。这些效应被Erastin增强，并被Ferrostatin-1（Fer-1）缓解。网络药理学和分子对接预测P53是AP在CRC治疗中的核心靶点之一。在LoVo和HCT8细胞中敲低和过表达P53导致下游信号通路发生变化。此外，使用PDX裸鼠模型的体内研究表明，AP抑制肿瘤生长，而这一效应被Fer-1减弱。SLC7A11和GPX4的表达水平，以及GSH/GSSG、MDA和游离铁含量的变化，与体外结果一致。结论：我们的数据表明，AP通过下调SLC7A11/GPX4信号通路诱导结直肠癌铁死亡，其中P53可能作为其靶点。
